name: Tsukimiya Ringo
source:
The teacher assigned to Haruka's class, Class A.
He's also a famous idol, known for being a crossdresser. He's very popular amongst his students as he helps and encourages them.

[spoiler]It is revealed that he was forced to crossdress to become an idol.[/spoiler]
